_description: Cycle 34 (SPEC 0022 design): which 1B-scale action to run on the RTX 5090. Beliefs seeded from F24/F45/F50 (exchange rate holds at 46-121M), F31 (contractivity degrades with width), F53 (KD refuted), and the prabhasa 1.13B precedent (5.25B tokens in ~71h at 20.9k tok/s). EqLM twin throughput estimate ~7-8k tok/s per arm at 1B compute-matched geometry (denser per-token than prabhasa's Mamba hybrid): 5B tokens/arm ~7-8 days, both arms ~15 GPU-days sequential.
cost_units: 5090 GPU-days; 0.12 means ~8 GPU-days trades against one nat, so the ~15-day decisive run stays reachable only if genuinely more informative than week-scale options

candidates.name: twin_5B_ladder
candidates.description: Both arms (tied EqLM + explicit twin, compute-matched, identical data) to 5B tokens; milestone evals at 1B/2.5B/5B; pre-registered kill gate at 1B tokens; SFT the tied arm afterwards

candidates.name: twin_2p5B_week
candidates.description: Both arms to 2.5B tokens, milestones at 0.5B/1B/2.5B; weaker usability evidence (2.5B tokens rarely yields a usable assistant)

candidates.name: tied_only_10B_vs_public
candidates.description: Single tied arm to 10B tokens vs public checkpoints (Pythia/SmolLM); breaks like-for-like so H_A evidence is weak; best usability per GPU-day

candidates.name: hybrid_probe_prabhasa_core
candidates.description: Tie the core of a prabhasa-style 353M hybrid and measure the exchange rate there; directly informs prabhasa transfer, little else

candidates.name: offline_reanalysis_only
candidates.description: Null action: quantization/iteration sweeps on existing 121M checkpoints; carries almost no evidence about 1B scale
